heroSubtitle: A modern, high-performance mail platform built for scale, security, and developer experience.
modernWebmailDesc: A blazing-fast, responsive web interface built with cutting-edge web technologies for a seamless experience across all devices.
enterpriseSecurityDesc: End-to-end encryption, DKIM signing, SPF validation, and DMARC enforcement keep your communications secure and verifiable.
blazingFastDesc: Powered by JMAP, the next-generation mail protocol, delivering instant sync and dramatically reduced bandwidth usage.
scalableStorageDesc: From gigabytes to petabytes — a storage architecture that grows with your organization without sacrificing performance.
jmapProtocolDesc: Modern, efficient alternative to IMAP with real-time push updates and minimal data transfer.
multiDomainDesc: Manage multiple domains from a single interface with per-domain policies and configuration.
rbacDesc: Fine-grained permissions with hierarchical roles for teams of any size.
realtimeNotificationsDesc: Instant delivery of mail, chat, and system notifications with WebSocket-powered updates.
sieveFilteringDesc: Powerful server-side mail rules with a visual rule builder and full Sieve script support.
dkimRotationDesc: Automated key rotation with per-domain control for maximum email authentication security.
redirectToKeycloak: You will be redirected to Keycloak for authentication
footerTagline: Secure, fast, and scalable email for modern organizations.
